=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2270-2323 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `report_purge_drop_ok != 1`, the step skips `gh pr merge --auto` on purpose. `report_merge_requested` stays empty, so control falls into the `else` branch at 2321-2323, which sets `report_delivery="pr_open"` and prints the warning the last run rewrote: it says GitHub refused `--auto` and tells the operator to enable auto-merge or set `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_VIA_PR=false`.
  WHY: On the purge-failure path no `--auto` call was made, so the job log shows two contradicting warnings and sends the operator to change correct repository settings instead of fixing the undeleted purge deletions. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 said MAJOR (reported twice, under CORRECTNESS and ERROR PATHS); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said NIT; the highest is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Every call without `--auto` that targets the default branch must end up in one of three states: already behind `_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard`, put behind it here, or listed in the PR body with why it is exempt (a non-protected base, e.g. `stable`)." Goal 2 adds: "No workflow or script merges into a ruleset-protected base with a direct `gh pr merge` while GitHub reports `blocked`."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml `commit_push` merge fallback (lines 1546-1555, direct merge at line 1552) and the tests/test_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard.py `DIRECT_MERGE_EXEMPT` entry (lines 270-274)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The workflow reads `DEFAULT_BRANCH` from `repos/${REPO}` (line 1489), `REPO` is `${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}` (line 1486), and the PR is created with `base="${DEFAULT_BRANCH}"` (line 1532). When the `--auto` error matches `auto.?merge (is )?not allowed|not allowed for this repository|enablePullRequestAutoMerge` (line 1551), it runs a direct `gh pr merge "${SYNC_PR_NUMBER}" --repo "${REPO}" "--${MERGE_METHOD}" --match-head-commit "${MERGE_HEAD_SHA}"` (line 1552) with no `_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard`. With a GH_PAT bypass actor the merge can land while required statuses are missing. The `DIRECT_MERGE_EXEMPT` reason ("consumer repos only" / "never merges into this repo's ruleset-protected main") is not enforced in code: the job `if:` at line 65 skips the source repo only when `allow_workflow_edits == false`, and line 1298 sends an invalid `UPDATER_PR_DELIVERY_ENABLED` value to this legacy path. The base is the default branch (for this repo `main`, which ruleset 25851281 protects), not a non-protected one, and the PR description documents no qualifying exemption.
- requirement: "Static test: every non-`--auto` `gh pr merge` against the default branch in workflows and scripts is guarded or on an explicit exemption list."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard.py::_direct_merge_scan_paths
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The scanner at tests/test_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard.py:279-284 globs only `.github/workflows/*.yml`, `.github/workflows/*.yaml`, `workflow-templates/*.yml`, `workflow-templates/*.yaml` and `scripts/**/*.sh`. Python files are not scanned, so a future direct `gh pr merge` in a Python script would not be detected.
- requirement: "A non-docs file in a deterministic-skip PR → full final CI, not docs-only." (LINKED ISSUE #10151, Tests section; also an unmet test in the PR description's acceptance list)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py alongside `test_det_skip_ensure_final_ci_behaviour`, or a test driving `_pr_ensure_final_ci` from scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh with a mixed docs/non-docs changed-file list
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR's parametrized test (tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:11362-11390 / 11366-11390) stubs `_pr_ensure_final_ci` with `echo "CALL $*"` and never runs the docs-only classification in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh. No hunk adds a test that a non-docs file yields full final CI through `deterministic_skip_ensure_final_ci` / the new no-wait skip path.
- requirement: When `report_purge_drop_ok != 1`, the workflow skips the `gh pr merge` call on purpose, but `report_merge_requested` stays empty, so the step still reaches the warning that says GitHub refused `--auto`.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml lines 2270-2323
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The final warning blames an auto-merge configuration problem and tells the operator to enable auto-merge or switch to direct delivery, although the real cause is a purge-drop failure.
- requirement: Approach step 3 of the linked issue: "keep the bounded landing wait, but treat a timeout as `report_delivery=pr_auto_merge_pending`, a non-error outcome" and "deep-audit and api-redundancy readers then fall back to the PR branch or the previous report, as they do today when the wait expires. Confirm that fallback before relying on it."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml deep-audit job `if:` (around line 2447) and the commit_report landing wait (around line 2300-2311)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: With the direct merge removed, the report usually lands after a docs-only final CI plus deterministic skip, which often takes longer than the default 10-minute `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_MERGE_WAIT_MINUTES`. Delivery then mostly ends as `pr_auto_merge` (the existing value, not a new `pr_auto_merge_pending`), and deep-audit and api-redundancy are skipped. The agents.d fragment documents the skip, but the fallback confirmation the issue requires is absent.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:Lines 2270-2276, then lines 2321-2323 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When the purge-drop amend or force-push fails, `report_purge_drop_ok` is 0, `gh pr merge` is skipped on purpose and `report_merge_requested` stays empty. Control then falls into the `pr_open` branch, whose rewritten text now says GitHub refused `--auto` because of repository settings.
  WHY: The log shows contradicting warnings (line 2271 vs line 2323) and the operator may change correct repository settings or disable the PR route, while the real cause, a PR still carrying the purge deletions, goes unfixed. Suggested fix: print the GitHub-refusal sentence only when `report_purge_drop_ok` is 1.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Every call without `--auto` that targets the default branch must end up in one of three states: already behind `_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard`; put behind it here; listed in the PR body with why it is exempt (a non-protected base, e.g. `stable`)." plus Goal 2 "No workflow or script merges into a ruleset-protected base with a direct `gh pr merge` while GitHub reports `blocked`."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml, the `commit_push` legacy ai-sync/stable delivery (line 1552), and its `DIRECT_MERGE_EXEMPT` entry in tests/test_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard.py.
  Evidence of absence: The fallback reads `DEFAULT_BRANCH` (line 1489) and creates the PR with `base="${DEFAULT_BRANCH}"` (line 1532). When the `--auto` refusal matches (line 1551), it runs a direct `gh pr merge ... --match-head-commit` (line 1552) with no guard, which a GH_PAT bypass actor can land with required statuses missing. The exemption reason is not enforced: the `if:` at line 65 and line 1298 can route this repo to the path. The base is the default branch, not a non-protected one.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml line 2323: emit the GitHub-refusal sentence only when `report_purge_drop_ok` is 1 (~3 lines).
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml line 2323: the cause list leaves out GitHub's "clean status" refusal, which update_workflows.yml line 1551 already handles; add "or reports the PR already mergeable (clean status)" (~1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Not re-raised (accepted residuals): deep-audit fallback, non-docs full-final-CI test, Python files not in the direct-merge sweep, PR-body exemption list (4 related items).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
